CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content organization is stated.

COD.rationale: Each p0/current/nX entry pairs explicit content position and origin/representation metadata for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to these contents' presentation is stated.

C.rationale: Report explicitly identifies colored items and their coordinates for current time points.

D.rationale: Each content position is paired with an explicit origin/representation metadata line, separating identification from representation/status.

O.rationale: Origin/representation records explicitly describe how each content instance is represented/presented at the stated time.
